svg.title: The ending keeps both the tradeoff and objection
svg.desc: Retain both tradeoff and objection on the ending page within the reconstructed conversation. The decision to publish does not erase the argument against it. Keep the recurring home window and shelves distinct from institutional review settings; this domestic interior remains reconstructed.
